text: Frozen spatial4s 0.1 contract and build skeleton in sibling commit bfd5603: Dim/D2/D3; extensible validated CoordinateUnit and CoordinateConvention; ephemeral and caller-supplied persistent Frame identity; immutable threaded FrameRegistry restoration; explicit alignment for independently restored owners; Point/Vec owner types; frame-neutral affine coefficients; and an explicit disambiguation from the unrelated frame4s dataframe library. spatial4s clean gates: checkAll, testFullOptJS, docsCheck, git diff --check.
